messages:
amelia_cs: @sofia_lodestar thanks for the intake form. Can you confirm whether the model will see PHI? Also need sample prompts + expected failure modes. :wave:

sofia_lodestar: Hi! No PHI — only order metadata and product descriptions. We'll send sample prompts and a small labeled set later today. Happy to join an enablement call next week.

amelia_cs: Great — can you attach a CSV with ~100 examples and a short doc listing sensitive token patterns (skus, CC fragments, etc)? We'll run safety/eval sweeps and a quality check on staging.

intake-bot: New intake created: lodestar-retail-2026-03 model request. Intake ID: LOD-5821. Priority: high.

leo_se: FYI we recommend starting on hosted with a canary route then move to Dedicated if throughput demands it. If p99 latency target is <60ms we can push quantized 7B; otherwise plan for a 13B variant. @ravi_infra can you provision a staging slot for LOD-5821?

ravi_infra: On it. Allocated a staging GPU pool (3xA10). Provisioning SSO creds for Lodestar engineers, ETA ~24h. I'll post the kube job + endpoint once deployed.

sofia_lodestar: Appreciate it. One note on timeline — we're mid-term with renewals in 6 weeks; if onboarding slips we risk escalation. Can we get a go/no-go by end of next week?

amelia_cs: Understood — we'll prioritize this intake. Action items: Sofia upload examples + failure cases by EOD; Ravi confirm staging endpoint ASAP; Leo to prepare model/size/cost recommendation; Amelia to run safety evals and report preliminary pass by Friday.

leo_se: Also capture targets in the intake: latency p99 50ms, F1 > 0.85 on product mapping task, top-1 accuracy > 92% for SKU normalization. Added to intake notes.

sofia_lodestar: Upload complete (shared drive link dropped in thread). Also request an enablement session for their platform engineers Tue 10am PT if possible.

amelia_cs: I'll schedule a 45m enablement + handoff with @leo_se and @ravi_infra. Calendar invite incoming. :calendar: If any blockers surface I'll escalate to renewals.

ravi_infra: Staging pool deployed. Endpoint (basic auth): https://staging.redwood.internal/LOD-5821/health. Quick smoke test example:
```
curl -s -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"prompt":"map product name to SKU: 'Deluxe Widget'"}' https://staging.redwood.internal/LOD-5821/infer
```

amelia_cs: Thanks everyone — tagging renewals for visibility. I'll post the safety/evals summary and go/no-go recommendation by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
